# coolify_instance_email_settings (Resource)

Manages Coolify instance-wide SMTP and Resend settings (`GET`/`PATCH /settings/email`). This is an instance singleton. It requires a **root-team** API token (team 0) belonging to a root-team admin or owner. **Requires Coolify >= v4.3.10** (the route is absent on v4.3.9 and older; acceptance tests skip when the API is missing).

Team notification email (`coolify_notification_email`) can inherit these values with `use_instance_email_settings = true`.

On destroy, `smtp_enabled` and `resend_enabled` are set to `false`; credentials are left unchanged. Import with id `current`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Instance-wide SMTP / Resend settings (Coolify >= v4.3.10).
# Requires a root-team API token. Import: terraform import coolify_instance_email_settings.main current
resource "coolify_instance_email_settings" "main" {
  smtp_enabled      = true
  smtp_host         = "smtp.example.com"
  smtp_port         = 587
  smtp_encryption   = "starttls"
  smtp_from_address = "alerts@example.com"
  smtp_from_name    = "Coolify"
  smtp_username     = "smtp-user"
  smtp_password     = "change-me-in-production"
  smtp_ehlo_domain  = "mail.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `resend_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Resend API key. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `resend_enabled` (Boolean) Whether instance Resend delivery is enabled.
- `smtp_ehlo_domain` (String) Hostname sent with SMTP EHLO. Set a valid hostname, or omit to use Coolify's default. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.10 ([coollabsio/coolify#11398](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/pull/11398)).
- `smtp_enabled` (Boolean) Whether instance SMTP delivery is enabled.
- `smtp_encryption` (String) SMTP encryption. One of `starttls`, `tls`, or `none`.
- `smtp_from_address` (String, Sensitive) SMTP From address. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `smtp_from_name` (String, Sensitive) SMTP From display name. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `smtp_host` (String, Sensitive) SMTP host. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `smtp_password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.
- `smtp_port` (Number) SMTP port (1-65535).
- `smtp_timeout` (Number) SMTP timeout in seconds (>= 0).
- `smtp_username` (String, Sensitive) SMTP username. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve after import.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Always `current` (team is implied by the API token).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Instance singleton: always import as "current". Requires a root-team token.
terraform import coolify_instance_email_settings.main current
```
